name: Acne Scars
description: Acne scars are visible marks left on the skin after acne lesions have healed. These can vary in appearance and severity, from shallow indentations to deeper pits or raised areas.
causes: Skin damage from picking or squeezing acne
symptoms: Raised or sunken areas of skin
Redness or discoloration around the scarred area
Irregular skin texture in the affected area
risk_factors: History of picking or squeezing acne lesions
ingredients_to_avoid: Harsh exfoliants that can irritate the skin further

daily_routine.step: Cleanse the skin with a gentle cleanser
daily_routine.purpose: Remove dirt and oil to prevent clogged pores

daily_routine.step: Use an acne-fighting serum containing retinoids or vitamin C
daily_routine.purpose: Promote cell turnover and reduce discoloration
Provide hydration to support skin repair
Protect the skin from UV damage which can worsen scarring

lifestyle_tips: Maintain a healthy diet rich in antioxidants
Stay well-hydrated by drinking plenty of water
Avoid touching or picking at acne lesions
Manage stress levels through exercise and relaxation techniques
common_myths: Picking at acne will make the scars go away faster - False, this can worsen scarring
Sun exposure helps clear up acne scars - False, UV rays can actually worsen scarring and lead to hyperpigmentation
All skin types should use the same treatment for acne scars - Not necessarily true, treatments should be tailored to individual skin type and severity of scarring
when_to_consult_doctor: If you have severe or persistent acne that doesn't respond to over-the-counter products, if you experience significant discomfort from your acne, or if you're concerned about the appearance of acne scars.
prevention: Wash your face twice daily with gentle cleansers

severity_levels.mild: Shallow scars that are barely visible and do not affect the skin's texture significantly.
severity_levels.moderate: Visible indentations or elevated areas on the skin that can be seen but may not cause significant discomfort.
severity_levels.severe: Deep, noticeable depressions in the skin that can impact both appearance and self-esteem.

expert_tips: Consult a dermatologist to determine the best treatment options for your specific condition
Be patient as results from treatments may take several months to show
Consistency is key - follow the recommended routine or treatment plan consistently
